changes.reason: CloudFormation guide: a stack instance must use a subnet and security groups of its own stack.
Design record: stack instance placement is refused inside the create transaction when it names foreign network rows.

The stack create transaction calls the instance placement check before commit, so a refused placement stores no stack or instance claim and starts no guest launch. Every other resource path, event and finalization is unchanged.

models.limits: Finite ordering and admission model of one launch, one network ownership operation and one creator. Its network admission abstracts same-owner and validity checks as Booleans: it does not model SQL, the instance's subnet and security-group rows, CloudFormation resource order, IAM evaluation, a real guest or a Go refinement proof. The Go test with the runtime double establishes that a foreign placement is refused inside the create transaction, before the journal entry and the launch.

changes.reason: Stack instance fixtures are placed in their own stack's subnet and security group, and a new test refuses every other placement before commit and before a guest launch.

New placement check for a stack instance, run inside the stack's create transaction after its network rows exist: the subnet and every security group must be rows of the same stack in one VPC, which is what DescribeInstances already requires to read the instance back. Compile-time validation and permissions are unchanged.
